_comment_meta: Confluent Cloud HTTP Sink Connector — replaces the Node deliverer's POST to /internal/push with a managed Connector pushing learner.recommendations records straight to server.js. Paste into Confluent Cloud → Connectors → + Add connector → 'HTTP Sink'. Replace <CLUSTER_API_KEY>, <CLUSTER_API_SECRET>, and <PUBLIC_URL> (ngrok or deployed server.js host).
name: maverick-recommendation-http-sink
_comment_endpoint: server.js exposes /internal/connector-push which accepts the raw recommendation envelope and fans out via SSE — same as /internal/push but without the join_url enrichment (the connector forwards the recommendation; server.js can optionally create the Waterr meeting and push the join URL via SSE).
_comment_format: JSON_SR matches what Flink writes when value.format='json-registry'. The HTTP Sink natively understands SR-encoded JSON and posts the decoded payload.
